rows.behavior: ADRs 0001, 0011, 0012, 0014 and 0020 each have a dated correction that names packages/kmctl/apm/apm.yml and links ADR 0045; ADR 0012's also names packages/kmaudit/apm/apm.yml and every path in release-tag.yml's paths filter.
rows.fails_when: any of the five lacks such a correction, ADR 0012's misses kmaudit's apm.yml or a path release-tag.yml watches, or the link to 0045 is missing

rows.behavior: The decisions index notes for ADR 0012 and ADR 0014 name no path that ADR 0045 removed (a bare apm/apm.yml or the apm/ folder), and every earlier release-docs test, including kmctl check over the bundle, passes.
rows.fails_when: either index note still names apm/apm.yml or 'in apm/' outside packages/, or any test in test_release_docs.py fails
